Basics of monetization

Rule 1

Price everything in time

time to acquire = cost ÷ income per hour
energy refill, 50 coins0.5 h
shelf upgrade, 300 coins3 h
new building, 600 coins6 h
sword, 1,000 coins10 h
at 100 coins an hour. Now they can be ranked.
$4.99 → 500 gems → 5 hours
five dollars for five hours of somebody's life
Rule 2

Goal before monetization

Nobody buys a shortcut to nowhere.
Jiao, Tang & Wang. Production and Operations Management, 31(9), 2022.
100,000 players tracked for three years. Performance follows an inverted U: winning too easily and being stuck both cut next week's play and next week's spend.
Difficulty is time to goal. This is rule one's curve with the price hidden inside it.
Figure. Next week's play time by last week's winning rate, relative to the 25 to 75% band. Player fixed effects, adult players, 655,869 player-weeks; whiskers 95% CI; dashed line is a guide. Estimates from the authors' working paper (SSRN 3871031, 15,120-player sample); the POM 2022 version reports the same inverted U on 100,000 players.

Rule 4

Kill inflation before it kills you

Δ wallet / hour  =  sources / hour  −  sinks / hour
Whatever offer you show this player, they will not buy it. They already have all the money in the world.  Cut the fattest source, widen the sink, add a rarer currency, overflow early and scarce late. None of it survives without a drain.
Rule 5

Basics of monetization

The order I build in, and why.
1IAP + starter packNo purchases means no funnel, no tests and no data. The starter pack is the fastest first conversion.
2One rewarded placement in the hubMonetizes the 95% who will never pay, without breaking the core loop.
3Battle passRecurring revenue and a daily reason to come back.
4Segmented offersOne price tag for a whale and a student is a mistake. Next slide.
5Personalized offersThe shop adapts the card to the player. Cap the generosity: the model does exactly what you optimized it for.
6LiveOps calendarIsolated containers that always route back to the core loop.
Rule 5

Offer segmentation

The bare minimum, three tiers
non-payer
core
whale
  • Offers refresh on the bought / declined trigger
  • Revise the price ladder monthly, with A/B tests
  • Every price here is an example. Adjust for your product.

Rule 5

LiveOps

LTV. Frozen City doubled revenue per download with events as the only lever.
×1.5
revenue. Monopoly GO!, the share AppMagic attributes to events.

event launches a month per top game in 2025.
Every spike is an event. Merge Mansion, daily revenue against its LiveOps calendar, June 5 to September 2, 2026. Five launches, each +28 to +41% on the week.
One long LTV driver, two to ten short events a week. Isolated containers that end. Every event routes the player back to the core loop.
